o.text: From Proto-Turkic *bel-le-. Cognate with Turkish bellemek, Chuvash палла (palla).
Ultimately a derivation from Proto-Turkic *tegir- (“to spin, turn”). Compare Azerbaijani diyir and Azerbaijani dığır all relating to a round object.
